manifest.name: Services
manifest.description: Start and stop the box's services
svc.d.djmount: Mounts media servers of the network as folders
svc.d.fritzcallmonitor: Shows calls on a FRITZ!Box on the TV
svc.d.inadyn: Keeps a dynamic DNS name up to date
svc.d.minidlna: Media server for TVs and players in the network
svc.d.nfs: Shares the box's folders over NFS
svc.d.samba: Shares the box's folders with Windows computers
svc.d.ushare: Media server for TVs and players in the network
svc.d.xupnpd: Offers TV and web TV channels to players in the network
svc.lead: Services that run in the background on the box. Running means a process of the name runs right now.
svc.missing_note: This image was built without them.
svc.none: This box carries none of these services.
